findings.claim_or_location: Paragraph 2: '...circulating free T4 (fT4) concentrations in the range of roughly 0.7–1.9 ng/dL (approximately 9–24 pmol/L) in euthyroid adults... [5, cohort]'
findings.issue: Citation [5] is Yeap et al. (Health In Men Study, PMID 27440910) — a cohort of older men (≥70 yr community-dwelling). Citing it as the basis for a general 'euthyroid adults' reference interval without flagging the population specificity (older male) is a mild population-annotation gap. The broader interval 0.7–1.9 ng/dL is plausible for general adults but this specific source supports only older men.
findings.recommended_fix: Append a population qualifier inline: '...in euthyroid adults (older men cohort, Yeap et al. [5, cohort]; general adult intervals detailed in Section B)' or supplement with a broader adult population cohort for this claim.

summary: Section A is physiologically accurate, mechanistically coherent, and well-sourced: all spot-checked PMIDs (26735261, 10718550, 38716305, 27440910) and first-author surnames confirmed correct; unit conversions verify numerically (×12.87); all inline citations use [N, tag] form with appropriate tags; brief coverage is complete. One minor population-annotation gap: reference [5] is an older-men cohort (Yeap, Health In Men Study) cited for a general adult fT4 range without flagging the population specificity — not a HALT-level issue but worth tightening in the wiki entry.
